dedupe_keys.name: dataset for the publication the use of voltage transformers for the measurement of power system subharmonics in compliance with international standards

description: Crotti Gabriella and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. The deposit provides an XLSX measurement collection supporting the named study of voltage-transformer use for power-system subharmonics and standards-compliance assessment. Coverage is the experiment reported in IEEE paper 10.1109/TIM.2022.3204318. The source does not enumerate all subharmonic frequencies, amplitudes or transformer types in the dataset abstract, so those fields remain unknown. This is distinct from the earlier harmonic-in-presence-of-subharmonics figure data, while possible shared apparatus is not treated as independent validation. Zenodo supplies the deposited data and native file inventory with open access under cc-by-4.0. Sample values, linked files and code were not read or executed during source checks. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations.
